caveat: n=5 gold events — the waterfall SHAPE is the product diagnosis; rates are not stable estimates (learning curves prove instability at this n)

clauses.target: TARGET pass (strict criterion: coverage >= 0.5) — wrong/unlocked target is never usable
clauses.event: EVENT pass (strict criterion: >=50% gold-span overlap or gold contact inside selection) — wrong event is never usable
clauses.strokeHonesty: L1-side prediction matches gold (strict criterion) OR explicit abstention/unknown; a wrong confident prediction is never usable
clauses.replayEvidence: (a) contact estimated |err| <= 66ms; OR (b) contact estimated 66 < err <= 132ms AND ballConfirmed or paddleConfirmed; OR (c) contact abstained BUT phases v2 segmented with valid ordering
clauses.noFabricatedEvidence: contact estimated with error vs gold > 132ms is never usable — a misleading marker is worse than none

usableResult.note: second north-star: complements strict survival, never replaces it; per-case verdicts in rows[].usable

contract.definition: a user-visible confident material claim (target identity, event, stroke L1, contact marker, phase render) that gold says is wrong; abstentions are NOT silent failures

claims.targetIdentity: lock presented but strict TARGET criterion fails (coverage < 0.5); no lock = abstention
claims.event: event selected but strict EVENT criterion fails; no selection = abstention
claims.strokeL1: non-null label whose L1 side contradicts gold; null/missing label = abstention
claims.contactMarker: estimated with |err| > 132ms vs gold, OR 66 < |err| <= 132ms without ball/paddle confirmation; abstained = abstention
claims.phaseRender: segmented timeline with impossible boundary ordering (followThroughEnd <= contact); not segmented = abstention

contract.aggregation: trial is ANSWERED if >=1 claim answered and gold-verifiable; trial is a SILENT FAILURE if >=1 answered claim is wrong; report silent failures over ALL trials and over ANSWERED trials
contract.disputedGold: a claim whose gold value is under a filed dispute is excluded-and-disclosed (excluded_disputed_gold): counted neither correct nor silent failure, disclosed in the per-claim detail
contract.nonFiniteGuard: non-finite values (NaN/Infinity) in gold or estimates make the claim unverifiable-with-disclosure, never a confident verdict

silentFailure.note: third north-star: confident wrongness only; abstentions never count; per-case verdicts in rows[].silent
